question: Sarojini Naidu served as President of the Indian National Congress in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1925**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** served as President of the Indian National Congress in **1925**.
 
• She was the first Indian woman to hold the position of President of the Indian National Congress.
 
• Her presidency marked a significant milestone in the Indian independence movement.
 
• She was known as the "**Nightingale of India**" for her contributions to poetry and Indian literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an important figure in India's struggle for independence and played a key role in the Civil Disobedience Movement and the Quit India Movement.
 
• She was also a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and worked alongside other prominent leaders like Jawaharlal Nehru and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
 
• In addition to her political work, she was a renowned poet and writer, and her literary works include "T**he Golden Threshold**" and "**The Bird of Time**".
 
• After India's independence, she became the **first woman to serve as a governor in independent India**, appointed as the **Governor of the United Provinces (now Uttar Pradesh)**.
